player_act: Shiki attempts directed chakra interference to neutralize newly activated thermal destruction fuuinjutsu within ~1 second of trigger while standing ~3m away. He does NOT physically touch cylinder, move/evacuate people, open cylinder, speak, treat burn or take any additional voluntary action.
adjudication: Given Shiki's exceptional 1283 precision chakra control and distinct visibly active feed-lines, directed emission can break energy feed at exposed junction, but not decode unknown seal system. Main thermal charge prevented from reaching cylinder; short transient discharge generates steam/heat at lid edge and burns guard's left forearm before second guard frees him. No major explosion. Central circuit interrupted and primary destruction seal disabled. Other seals unknown. Significant chakra focus expenditure, no full fuinjutsu mastery claimed; no RNG because controlled feed is observed and Shiki's extraordinary accuracy grounds partial success under pressure.

timeline.visible: From about3m Shiki projects fine directed chakra at converging feed line of moving red seal rather than energy accumulator directly, knowing only observed direction of active flow and not seal-key or author. Red script oscillates and some elements flare brighter, briefly increasing risk of surge.

Shiki's fine interference breaks powering connection. Short arc and steam puff char border guard1's caught LEFT sleeve; guard2 autonomously cuts trapped cloth with kunai and pulls both away. No full cylinder-destroying blast. The red symbols darken. No Shiki free rescue move.

Jun asks if both alive, guard1 left forearm superficial partial thickness scald/contact burn with reddening and small blisters, conscious and functional, guard2 uninjured. Jun professionally understands hazardous feed interruption and jokes irritably 'В следующий раз предупреждайте, если собираетесь делать что-нибудь настолько безумное', reacts uneasily to Shiki's unfamiliar composed demeanor but not universal panic.

Wagon3 metal cylinder remains intact in open cold compartment. Previously hidden label now legible: 'МЕДИЦИНСКИЙ КОНТЕЙНЕР / М-4 / 032', 'БИОЛОГИЧЕСКИЙ МАТЕРИАЛ', 'Серия: 17', 'Температурный режим: криогенное хранение'; temp destruction feed broken but cooling unstable. Through cloudy view a few sealed ampoules with pale liquid and an unidentified tissue-wrapped sample in transparent support; cannot identify contents visually. End plate engraved distinct records 'ДОНОР: 032-D' / 'РЕЦИПИЕНТ: 032-R'. Numbers suggest two registry roles; identities unknown. Jun asks whether to take the canister or wait for seal experts; hidden secondary protection not excluded.

scene.location: Third wagon under concealed floor, Ivovy Brod customs post, Kusa territory
scene.shiki: Uninjured, ~3m from chamber, directed precision chakra emission at thermal destruction seal enabled partial successful disruption, cost focused chakra. No contact, additional movement/speech or opening sample assigned. Significant earlier chakra spent on combat.
scene.hazard: Primary thermal self-destruction fuuinjutsu charge circuit interrupted, no major explosion, red markings blackened. Closed sample cylinder remains intact, cold chamber temperature control unstable, unknown secondary seals may remain. Heat flare injured guard1 briefly.
scene.guards: Guard1 left sleeve freed by guard2; superficial partial thickness burn to LEFT forearm, alive alert. Guard2 unhurt. Jun remains with RIGHT rib injury, near hatch, offers choices of seizure or seal-expert call, not waiting in absolute stasis.
scene.sample: Cold 80cm metal cylinder intact label M-4 / 032, BIOLOGICAL MATERIAL, Series17, cryogenic storage, engraved DONOR: 032-D and RECIPIENT: 032-R. Hazy glass shows unidentified tissue sample and small ampoules; neither donor nor recipient person identified; no additional tampering or diagnosis performed.
scene.patient: Earlier undocumented adult live patient in wagon2 already departed to Kusa hospital with chief Kadzama Ritsu, guarded Minase Tiyo, oxygen support and unknown IV drip maintained, reserve dose majority saved and small sample lab-sealed; no arrival confirmed.
scene.prisoners: Two attackers captured alive, female with limb motor deficit, male shoulder/hand injury, under Kusa guard; other 9 trader persons also held. No proven common faction, no premature Konoha conspiracy.
scene.next_gate: 18:11:21, user to decide sample handling, further examination or other. Cold system unstable, secondary seals unknown, possible risk to contents. NPCs independently safeguard perimeter.
